runs with it on, instead of the action's own.

such as destroying a machine no provisioner made. The set-up says
this instead of asking. Empty when it can be changed.

kind.description:
`resource` for an argument of a provisioner that sizes the machine:
its CPUs, memory or disk. `text` for one whose value has several
lines. `boolean` for a yes or no, which the set-up asks as a switch.
Empty for any other argument.

secret.description:
What is given is a secret, such as a password: it is not shown as it
is typed, nor kept, nor written to a job's output.

values.description:
The values a provisioner's argument takes, when it is a choice of a
few. Empty for one that takes any text.

Catalogue.description:
What a plugin offers to choose from when a machine is made, as sets of
the kind's arguments. A provider declares the ones it has; a choice sets
those arguments it names, and the others take their settings or defaults.

images.description: The images it starts machines from.

regions.description: The regions or zones it makes them in.

sizes.description: The sizes it offers, such as 2 vCPU and 4 GiB.

CatalogueChoice.description:
One of what a plugin offers: a size, an image or a region, as the values
it gives the arguments of the kind.

default.description: Whether a machine gets it when no other is chosen.

id.description:
Its id, which the kind's arguments do not take: what is chosen is the
`values` it sets.

values.description:
The arguments it sets, by their names. One not named keeps its
setting or default.

Collection.description:
A list of things a provisioner holds, such as the storage pools of a
server. Its items come with the provisioner's status, and its actions are
the provisioner's own: some make an item, some act on one item, whose
key fills their arguments, and some act on the whole list.

columns.description: The values each item shows besides its name, in order.

group.description: The group of the provisioner's page it is listed in.

key.description:
The names that identify an item, such as `pool` and `volume`. A
collection within another starts with that one's key.

kinds.description:
The kinds of resource that are its items, such as `machine`, in
place of items the status gives: its item actions are offered on
the page of each resource of those kinds the provisioner made.

label.description: What one item is called, such as `Storage pool`.

list.description: The actions on the whole list, such as pruning.

new.description: The actions that make a new item.

plural.description: What several are called, such as `Storage pools`.

remove.description: The item action that removes one.

show.description: The action that prints the list, for a caller that has no table.

within.description:
The collection whose items hold these, such as the pools that hold
volumes. Each item of that one lists those that belong to it.

CollectionAction.description: An action of a provisioner as one of a collection's.

action.description: The provisioner's action, by its name.

arguments.description:
The argument of the action each part of the key fills, where its
name is not the part's own: `{"volume": "name"}`.

label.description:
What it is called where its item is known already, such as `Grow`.
The action's own label when empty.

CollectionColumn.description: A value an item of a collection shows.

ProvisionerInfo.description: Something a plugin creates machines with, for a saved host's profile.

actions.description: Its plugin's own actions, such as listing images or pruning.

arguments.description:
What creating a machine takes: the provisioner's own arguments first,
then those of its machines.

collections.description:
What it holds that can be listed, such as storage pools, each with
the actions of its items.

id.description:
Its id, which stays when it is renamed. In the list of types, the
type itself.

kinds.description: What it can make: `machine`, and kinds its plugin names.

message.description: What it said with that state, such as why it cannot be reached.

missing_secrets.description: The required ones that have no value. Not looked at in a plugin's listing.

name.description:
The name it is registered under, such as `ovh-incus`. In the list of
types, the type itself.

node.description: The node it lives on, when a feature of that host offered it, by name.

own.description:
The names of the provisioner's own arguments, which say where it is,
such as an Incus server. Their values are kept as its settings.

problem.description:
Why it cannot be used here, as a sentence that says what to change.
Empty when it can.

secrets.description: The rookery secrets it is given.

settings.description: The values of its own arguments that are kept, by name.

setup.description:
`seed`: the machine boots with rookery's cloud seed and sets itself up.
`apply`: rookery applies the profile over SSH once the machine answers.

type.description: The plugin's provisioner it is, as `PLUGIN/ID`, such as `incus/vm`.

verbs.description:

`stop`, `list`, `log`.

actions.description:

resource's id.

catalogue.description:

its arguments: the sizes, images and regions it knows.

description.description:
What it makes, as its plugin says it, when that differs from the
provisioner's own description.

setup.description: For a machine: `seed` or `apply`, as for the provisioner.

spec.description:
